Top models solve nearly every task family at least once, but even leaders like OpenAI's GPT-6.2 Astra stumble when asked for 16 straight correct answers. items_all.summary: Release: datasette-charts 0.4a0 The new datasette-charts plugin has its own plugin hook to allow other plugins to define new chart types, but I hadn't actually used it for anything yet. I had Claude Opus 5.5 build an experimental plugins just to try out the hook and it came up with a bunch of friction points in the design. This release addresses those, which should make building additional chart plugins a whole lot more ergonomic. I've also added a website for the plugin, at charts.datasette.io . The new website includes a tutorial for plugin authors , and a gallery showing all of the core charts and annotations, each one linking to an interactive demo on Datasette Lite . items_all_raw.title: Google Deepmind's "Humanity's First Exam" shows top AI models still fail simple everyday tasks under repeated runs
items_all_raw.summary: Google Deepmind tests the reliability of 18 AI models with "Humanity's First Exam." Top models solve nearly every task family at least once, but even leaders like OpenAI's GPT-6.2 Astra stumble when asked for 16 straight correct answers. Visual perception accounts for 73 percent of errors, and more compute time doesn't fix the problem. The article Google Deepmind's "Humanity's First Exam" shows top AI models still fail simple everyday tasks under repeated runs appeared first on The Decoder .

items_all_raw.title: Robotics startup Embo raises $110 million in seed funding to build world-model AI for robots
items_all_raw.summary: Embo raised $110 million in seed funding to build a universal robot brain with world models. Its AI learns how the physical world works from internet video and practices motor skills in simulation. Google Deepmind, Meta, and MIT researchers are behind the startup as the race for general-purpose robotics AI accelerates. The article Robotics startup Embo raises $110 million in seed funding to build world-model AI for robots appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: Embo 籌集了 1.1 億美元的種子輪資金，旨在利用世界模型打造通用的機器人大腦。其人工智慧透過網際網路影片學習物理世界的運作方式，並在模擬環境中練習動作技能。Google Deepmind、Meta 以及麻省理工學院的研究人員是這家新創公司的幕後推手，隨著通用機器人人工智慧的競爭日益激烈。

items_all_raw.title: datasette-charts 0.4a0
items_all_raw.summary: Release: datasette-charts 0.4a0 The new datasette-charts plugin has its own plugin hook to allow other plugins to define new chart types, but I hadn't actually used it for anything yet. I had Claude Opus 5.5 build an experimental plugins just to try out the hook and it came up with a bunch of friction points in the design. This release addresses those, which should make building additional chart plugins a whole lot more ergonomic. I've also added a website for the plugin, at charts.datasette.io . The new website includes a tutorial for plugin authors , and a gallery showing all of the core charts and annotations, each one linking to an interactive demo on Datasette Lite . source_material.summary: Release: datasette-charts 0.4a0 The new datasette-charts plugin has its own plugin hook to allow other plugins to define new chart types, but I hadn't actually used it for anything yet. I had Claude Opus 5.5 build an experimental plugins just to try out the hook and it came up with a bunch of friction points in the design. This release addresses those, which should make building additional chart plugins a whole lot more ergonomic. I've also added a website for the plugin, at charts.datasette.io . The new website includes a tutorial for plugin authors , and a gallery showing all of the core charts and annotations, each one linking to an interactive demo on Datasette Lite .
